verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows financial data being extracted through a documented reconciliation report suite: Balance, Financial Actions, Payouts, and Settlement Breakdown reports, plus fraud reports. Webhooks can also stream account events to your systems or Amazon EventBridge. Nothing documents a complete export, open file formats, or an exit or migration path. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export, stated open formats (e.g. CSV/JSON) for reports, card/token vault portability or migration to another processor, coverage of non-financial data (customers, payment links, risk rules), and independent corroboration.
